definition: Synthesizing video of a speaking face driven by audio or motion, controlling lip sync and expression.
details: Synthesizing video of a speaking face driven by audio or motion, controlling lip sync and expression. Used for avatars and dubbing; also the core of modern deepfakes.

explainer.lead: Talking head generation synthesizes video of a speaking face driven by audio or motion, controlling lip sync and expression. It matters for avatars and dubbing and is the core of modern deepfakes.

tiers.eli5: Like puppeteering a face on screen so it speaks and shows expressions, using sound or movement as the strings.
tiers.practitioner: Engineers drive a generated face from audio or motion for avatars and dubbing; the pitfall is the deepfake misuse risk inherent to the technology.
tiers.paperLevel: Synthesizing video of a speaking face driven by audio or motion, controlling lip sync and expression; no formal definition or limit is given.

explainer.example: An audio track drives a generated face video in which the lips and expression follow the speech.
